newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser to raise stake in Grupo Modelo.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser to raise stake in Grupo Modelo.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc said Friday it intends to raise its stake in Mexican brewer Grupo Modelo SA de CV again, acquiring another 13.25 direct and indirect interest for a total 50.2 percent holding.

Anheuser, the world's largest beer brewer with brands such as Budweiser, said it expects the $550 million purchase to close sometime later this year. This will bring Anheuser's total investment in Grupo Modelo to about $1.6 billion.
Anheuser said it formally notified the controlling shareholders of Grupo Modelo that it is exercising its remaining options to acquire the 13.25 percent additional stake.

In May, Anheuser reached an agreement to increase its ownership in Grupo Modelo and its subsidiaries to 37 percent for an addititional $605 million investment. In 1993, Anheuser acquired a 17.7 percent interest in Grupo Modelo and its Diblo SA de CV subsidiary. It had options to increase its investments to 50.2 percent by the end of 1997.

"Our investment in Modelo is a key element in our strategy for international growth," August Busch III, chairman, said in a statement. "Mexico is the seventh largest beer market in the world. With highly favorable demographics and relatively low per-capita consumption, there is signficant growth potential in this market."
Modelo's brands include Corona, Modelo Especial, Pacifico, Negra Modelo and a number of regional brands brewed at eight breweries in Mexico. Anheuser holds a 45 percent share of the U.S. beer market.
